help.title: Console Help
help.charactersDesc: Schedule tasks, review progress, and explore and build with AI companions. Define character identity, roles, and skills in Character Settings, and coordinate plans on the Task Plans page.
help.plansDesc1: Supports immediate, scheduled, and recurring execution. Each run can encompass multi-turn planning. Use one-time plans for long-term construction goals and resume them seamlessly. Recurring plans run independently each cycle.
help.plansDesc2: Pausing a plan only stops future triggers. Plans also pause automatically on failures or budget exhaustion and must be resumed manually. Triggers missed during busy, offline, or server downtime are not retried.
help.plansDesc3: Calendar schedules run in their saved time zone. Daylight saving gaps are skipped and repeated times trigger once. Server-side scheduling continues when the browser is closed as long as the server remains running.
help.providersDesc: Save model and API configurations to select when creating or editing AI characters.
help.ttsDesc: Synthesizes replies into speech. Configure voices and test previews to attach to AI characters.
help.asrDesc: View interim captions while speaking and automatically confirm full sentences on pauses.
help.tokenRemoteHint: If running on a remote server, please contact your administrator for the token.

characters.empty: No AI characters yet. Click top right to create one.
characters.deleteDesc1: This will delete the character and cancel active runs. Plans and history remain preserved; unfinished plans pause and await reassignment. This action cannot be undone.
characters.deleteDesc2: Built blocks, model providers, and voice configurations remain intact.
characters.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete character {name}?
characters.deleteWarning: This action cannot be undone. The character's configuration and history will be permanently deleted.
characters.pollErrorHint: {error} Showing last synced data; resume actions once reconnected.
characters.listEmptyCreated: Created AI characters will appear here.
characters.capacityFullNote: Online slots full. Offline characters can still be created; free up a slot before bringing them online.
characters.offlineRetentionNote: Character settings are preserved when leaving the world and can rejoin anytime.
characters.welcomeDescLine1: Choose a model and give your AI character a name.
characters.welcomeDescLine2: It can join the world on standby or start directly with a task.
characters.lastRunFailed: Last connection or run failed. {reason} Details can be viewed in Activity Logs.
characters.checkConnectionModelHint: Please check world connection and model configuration.

characters.headingCreateDesc: Pick a name, select a saved model provider, and choose how it joins the world.

characters.providerWarningNoModel: This provider has no model configured. Fill in and save a model ID in Model Providers.

characters.roleDescriptionHint: Used for conversation and task planning. Tasks are scheduled separately, and actions require permissions.
characters.skillsSectionHint: Combine skills to guide task planning. Selecting skills does not grant permissions or start tasks automatically.
characters.restrictedExecution: Execution restricted: {missing} not enabled. Skills can still plan, but cannot perform unauthorized actions.

plans.title: Task Plans
plans.cronNote: Scheduled and recurring tasks are managed by the gateway; offline characters are skipped at scheduled times.
plans.noCharactersWarning: No characters available. Create one in 'AI Characters' first; existing plans and history remain viewable.
plans.stateCompletedDesc: Schedule finished. Can be triggered manually.
plans.statePausedDesc: Plan is paused and will not trigger automatically.
plans.stateArchivedDesc: Plan is archived; history and usage remain preserved.
plans.stateReadyDesc: Plan ready; awaiting schedule trigger or manual launch.
plans.inheritsCharacterBudget: Per-run limits inherited from the AI character at run start
plans.singleRunNoLimit: No call or token limits per run
plans.addTokensHint: Retains historical usage. Plan keeps its current status; manually resume if paused.
plans.reassignHint: Plan remains paused after reassignment; history and cumulative usage are preserved.
plans.welcomeDescLine1: Centrally schedule instant tasks, calendar schedules, or recurring patrols for AI companions.
plans.welcomeDescLine2: Select a plan on the left to track progress, or create a new plan directly.
plans.editorSubtitle: Configure goal, character, schedule trigger, and resource limits.
plans.characterLockedHint: This plan has an unfinished run. End it in Current Run, then select a character and save. Pausing the plan does not end the run.
plans.offlineAllowedNote: Future schedules allow selecting offline characters; skipped if still offline at runtime.
plans.goalPlaceholder: E.g. Inspect three buildings near the camp, report their coordinates and changes, then finish.
plans.intervalStartHint: · Starts relative to creation time; first run occurs after one interval.
plans.queuePolicyHint: Queues when busy; max 1 queued item per plan. Missed offline runs are skipped.
plans.inheritSnapshotHint: Each run captures the AI character's current limits when it starts.
plans.totalBudgetHint: All runs (including manual) share this budget; plan pauses when exhausted.
plans.limitsFutureOnly: Applies only to future runs. Existing runs keep their goals, progress, and limits.
plans.runReportTooltip: Report may include planned steps; check Action Log for actual actions performed.
plans.queuedWaitingMessage: Waiting for current activity to finish; coalesced {count} repeated triggers without consuming budget.
plans.resumeRunPrompt: Retains existing progress and usage; resuming this run does not resume the plan. If limits are enabled, total budget must exceed consumed usage.
plans.resumeNoLimitNote: This run has no budget limits; actual usage will still be recorded after resuming.
plans.endRunWarning: Cannot resume this progress after ending. Completed actions and history remain preserved.
plans.unlimitedLimitsHint: No turn, token, or duration limits for each run.
